rationale: Price opened with a gap up but has since pulled back to the lower third of today's range (31.8%), sitting just above VWAP and the 9-EMA with no clear directional momentum — the last two high-volume candles show a spike to $122.92 followed by immediate rejection back to $122.78, suggesting indecision rather than a clean breakout or breakdown. Without a defined structural level to lean against for either direction, the risk/reward does not justify entry.
